sentences.say: On this day in eighteen sixty-nine, two men tried to corner America's gold.
sentences.show: On this day in 1869, two men tried to corner America's gold.

sentences.say: Jay Gould and his partner, James Fisk, had a plan. Buy up the gold, and force the price up on the New York Gold Exchange.
sentences.show: Jay Gould and his partner, James Fisk, had a plan. Buy up the gold, and force the price up on the New York Gold Exchange.

sentences.say: There was one problem. Every two weeks, the Treasury sold gold of its own.
sentences.show: There was one problem. Every two weeks, the Treasury sold gold of its own.

sentences.say: So they found a way in.
sentences.show: So they found a way in.

sentences.say: But on Friday, the twenty-fourth of September, President Grant ordered the Treasury to sell.
sentences.show: But on Friday, 24 September, President Grant ordered the Treasury to sell.

sentences.say: And the price collapsed. From one sixty-two and a half, to one thirty-three.
sentences.show: And the price collapsed. From 162½, to 133.

sentences.say: Less than three years later, he was assassinated in New York.
sentences.show: Less than three years later, he was assassinated in New York.

sentences.say: Every day has a story like this.
sentences.show: Every day has a story like this.

sentences.say: Follow for a new story, every day.
